q: The topological pressure P(φ) for a continuous function φ on a compact topological dynamical system (X,T) is defined via the variational principle as:
exp: Topological pressure: P(φ) = sup_{μ∈M(T)} (h_μ(T) + ∫φ dμ). Setting φ ≡ 0 recovers the variational principle for topological entropy. Equilibrium states are measures achieving the supremum. Pressure is the Legendre transform of entropy as a function of the potential φ.
